summary: C2 Blockchain, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of a convertible promissory note to Labrys Fund II, L.P. for $120,000 principal at a $100,000 purchase price (20% OID). Terms include 10% interest, 12-month maturity, unsecured, and conversion at 75% of the lowest VWAP over prior 10 days, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary debt issuance with conversion features and no change of control, tender offer, or strategic event.
